method: Actual inspection of identity, four style references, both generated raw images, 1x multi-background and nearest-neighbor 8x technical candidates.
independent_consolidated_feedback: 小暗暖灰眼缝；短颈窄领；眉心上扬收平保务实谨慎；灰发须小亮点合并块面，不增龄。源发耳完整，无实际裁切。
revision_response: v2缩短裸颈并收窄衣领，头脸占比提升，眉心略收平；小眼面积缩小但眼白仍偏亮，灰发须细块仍多。身份/衣色/四十多岁年龄保留，源发耳完整且alpha128四边均有余量。
technical_export_warning: Full/inset are isotropic NEAREST whole-canvas sampling, alpha128 and <=32-color MAXCOVERAGE quantization only; inset cannot repair genuine source clipping.
independent_decision: 选full v2：短颈窄领改善明显，40+与发须衣色成立，full眼白比inset更克制；源完整、导出bbox[5,5,72,97]。限制为灰发须仍细碎、眉心略忧，作为NN候选可交付。
